question: Do the two frozen J8Z three-charge parities have direct D4 orbit-operator relations that explain their exact public-law contrast, and do those two parity bits retain the selected full six-site contrast?
fork_classification: Two independent disjoint triple relations and their joint two-parity compression are reversible exact diagnostics on the same frozen pair/action; their combined zero-new-Born cost is within the inherited five-second local budget, so both are evaluated without a human ranking request.

hypotheses.two_stabilizer_relations: Both triple products are +1 orbit stabilizers under one private error and nontrivial zero-mean orbit characters under the other; the joint two-parity public law retains the six-site TV 3/4.
hypotheses.incomplete_operator_explanation: At least one direct orbit moment fails to equal its public-law parity moment, or the two parity bits lose some six-site contrast; retain the finite marginal finding but reject the proposed exact operator explanation.
hypotheses.censored: Any frozen source, first-record, action, flux, geometry, normalization, public/private, source-hash, CPU or no-new-Born gate fails; promote no partial relation.

model_boundary: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 instrument at p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0. First-flux mask 3591, deterministic full all-zero-charge first public record, equal-prior private errors [0,5,16] and [2,4,15], relation-free public action [1,30,32,34,35], complete action-conditioned second flux/charge/vacuum public laws. Private error supports are analysis-only; no action or decoder receives them.

matrix.cells: For each of two private errors, evaluate the two disjoint triple products and their six-site product using the frozen conjugated-star and orbit algebra. Replay each exact public-law Walsh moment, document a generator index for each nontrivial orbit character, and compare complete six-site TV to the exact joint two-parity TV. Check the 16-state equal-even-parity subspace versus the 64-state full cube and their exact masses.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact fixed error/action/charge-product cell; six operator products total, no stochastic sampling or sampling uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin J8X/J8Z direct laws and J6L/J6M geometry/orbit plus operator, composition and public-law source hashes; verify same first/second flux, first public mass one with all eligible first means +1, action-bound residual, second-site eligibility and commutation, involution, orbit/public Walsh equality, uniform law support, full-TV replay, and zero new Born/history/arm/bootstrap work.

acceptance: Both triple products and six-site product replay their direct public-law parity moments under both fixed private errors
Joint two-parity compression exactly replays selected complete second-public-record TV, or the proposed relation is explicitly rejected/censored
Conclusion limited to one finite deterministic-first pair/action; no operator automorphism or law pooling across sectors, full-IID information/risk, noisy JIT, scaling or threshold
stop_rule: Stop after the six frozen operator products, two-parity joint law and direct full-TV replay, or first integrity/5-CPU-second failure. No extra private errors, actions, sectors, Born laws, histories, or budget expansion.
